facts.fact: TIX in Dar es Salaam, run by TISPA, connects 66 networks, per TISPA's member list and the exchange's portal, as reported by tech.africa.
Traffic: about 205 Gbps (average) at TIX on 2026-09 (last week of September), on the exchange's own statistics as reported by tech.africa.
Traffic: about 110 Gbps (average) at TIX on 2025-09 (a year before late September 2026), on the exchange's own statistics as reported by tech.africa.
TIX average traffic rose from about 110 Gbps in September 2025 to about 205 Gbps in late September 2026, an increase of more than 80% in a year, on the exchange's own statistics.
TISPA's member list also covers smaller exchanges in Mwanza, Dodoma and Zanzibar besides TIX in Dar es Salaam, so local traffic in those cities need not go to Dar es Salaam.
TISPA describes TIX in Dar es Salaam as its main and most successful project, a local facility for exchanging internet traffic; the page has no date, so published date 2026-08-28 is used.
TISPA manages six IXPs: TIX (Dar es Salaam) plus Arusha (AIXP), Dodoma (DIXP), Mbeya (MBIXP), Mwanza (MIXP) and Zanzibar (ZIXP); the page has no date, so published date 2026-08-28 is used.

note: STELLARIX joined TISPA on 2025-09-19 and partners with the TIX community; no statement of membership at, or traffic over, an exchange.
Exchange statements concern Nigeria, Kenya and South Africa only; Tanzania appears only in the Starlink scheduled-2026 list.
Capital-raise release; names only a planned Raxio data centre in Tanzania, no exchange point in service, no traffic, content or reach statement.
National Internet Exchange Points are only a designated category; no exchange is stated in service.

facts.fact: The Ministry says Tanzania operates six Internet Exchange Points.
Internet Society Pulse's IXP Tracker lists 6 active exchange points in Tanzania with 43 members as of November 2026.
Internet Society Pulse's IXP Tracker lists active exchange points in Dar es Salaam, Arusha, Dodoma, Mwanza and Zanzibar as of November 2026.
The African IXP Association's undated list of exchange points, retrieved 2026-11-09, names for Tanzania: TIX in Dar es Salaam, with exchanges in Arusha, Mwanza and Zanzibar.
The African IXP Association's undated list, retrieved 2026-11-09, places Tanzania's exchange points in more than one city: Dar es Salaam, Arusha, Mwanza and Zanzibar.
Internet Society's report counts six IXPs in Tanzania, with 29% of local networks connected, and shows daily traffic at TIX.
Internet Society Pulse lists Tanzania among the countries with some of the largest increases in reported IXP memberships between March 2019 and March 2026.
